summary: City park page, camping information page and the Firefly booking form read, plus Google. RV sites are reservable (Firefly or by phone 608-462-2410); tents are first-come. So booking reservable false/fcfs always -> reservable true, operator (Firefly), fcfs some_sites. $35 confirmed. Phone empty -> 608-462-2410. No camping season published. Waterfront: not waterfront -> creekside proposed on imagery (pads 10-25 m from a ~10 m river over open grass); no photo confirmation.
flags: BOOKING: stored reservable false, fcfs 'always' (note prose) -> reservable true, platform operator, url https://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/CityofElroyCampground, fcfs some_sites. The city page: 'RV's should make reservations for electric sites' (tents first-come).

WATERFRONT (check): not waterfront -> creekside proposed, imagery only (no --AWH). On Esri imagery at 100 m half-width, the eight angled back-in pads run along the park loop road at about 43.7294-43.7300, -90.2686 to -90.2680 (stored point 43.72966,-90.26821). Their rear ends are about 10-25 m from the Baraboo River over mown grass and a footpath, with only scattered low brush on the bank; the 'wooded bank' in the stored evidence is not what the current imagery shows. The river is only about 10-12 m wide here, so creekside, not riverfront. The pads are the RV sites, sold by the night at $35 and not seasonal; there are no site numbers on any page. I found no photo of the pads to confirm the sightline, so the reviewer may prefer to keep not waterfront.
PHONE: '' (empty) -> 608-462-2410 (the city's camping reservation line, also Google's number for the campground). City Hall is 608-462-2400.

SEWER: the fee table says the $35 camper site 'Includes: Electric, Water, Sewer and dump station'. Whether 'Sewer' means a sewer hookup at the pad or just the dump station is unclear, so sewer is left unset. Electric amperage is not published, so electric is left unset too (the note says the pads have electric).

SEASON: nothing published (the old evidence's 'mid-May to mid-October' has no source on the current pages; the Trail Shop keeps weekend-only hours before Memorial Day and after Labor Day). Left unset. Camping is closed during fair week (last full weekend in June).
SITES: count 8 has no published source; eight pads are visible on imagery, consistent with it. Left as is.
GOOGLE: 4.4 stars over 26 reviews ('Schultz City Park Campground'); a city park, so no long-stay test applies.
PIN: 43.72966,-90.26821 is on the RV pads (OSM node). Fine. Google's point (43.72831,-90.26907) is the restroom/shelter area 165 m south.
